meta.project: NeuroBase 神经与认知科学基础知识库
meta.note: 版本/年份以出版社最新版为准；仅作推荐与导读，不复制版权原文与图表。
meta.annotation_note: note/note_en 为项目自撰的「知识点关联导读」，非教材原文引用；教材原句受版权保护，如需原文请查阅原书对应章节。

categories.name_zh: 认知神经科学与认知心理学
方法与技术（脑成像/电生理）

books.title: Principles of Neural Science
books.note: 从离子通道到动作电位、再到突触传递，建立神经信号的物理—化学底层框架；理解它，才能解释 EEG/BCI 测到的信号从何而来。
books.note_en: Builds the physical–chemical groundwork from ion channels to action potentials and synaptic transmission — the basis for where EEG/BCI signals come from.

books.title: Neuroscience
books.note: 以系统视角把神经元、感觉运动与脑区串成整体地图，适合先建立“从细胞到系统”的全局框架。
books.note_en: A systems view that links neurons, sensory/motor circuits and brain regions — ideal for first building a cell-to-system map.

books.title: Neuroscience: Exploring the Brain
books.note: 图文讲清神经元、感觉与运动通路，零基础首选；可与 EEG 电极采集原理对照阅读。
books.note_en: Clear, figure-rich coverage of neurons and sensory/motor pathways — the best zero-basics starting point; pairs well with EEG acquisition principles.

books.title: Fundamental Neuroscience
books.note: 在分子—环路—行为三层之间搭桥，适合理解记忆与可塑性如何落到突触与环路层面。
books.note_en: Bridges molecular, circuit and behavioral levels — useful for seeing how memory and plasticity map onto synapses and circuits.

books.title: From Neuron to Brain
books.note: 从单个神经元的实验讲起，深入离子通道、突触与信号传导，强化机制层面的理解。
books.note_en: Starts from single-neuron experiments and goes deep into channels, synapses and signaling — strengthens mechanistic understanding.

books.title: The Cognitive Neurosciences
books.note: 综述文集，覆盖注意、记忆、语言等方向的前沿进展，适合做专题查证与扩展阅读。
books.note_en: A review collection covering the frontiers of attention, memory and language — good for topical deep-dives.

books.title: Cognitive Neuroscience: The Biology of the Mind
books.note: 以认知功能为纲，讲清注意、记忆、语言等对应哪些脑机制，是认知神经科学的主线教材。
books.note_en: Organized by cognitive function; explains the brain mechanisms behind attention, memory and language — the mainline cognitive neuroscience text.

books.title: The Student's Guide to Cognitive Neuroscience
books.note: 把认知功能与方法、实验范式结合来讲，帮助把任务范式与脑信号联系起来。
books.note_en: Combines cognitive functions with methods and paradigms — helps link task designs to brain signals.

books.title: Cognition, Brain, and Consciousness
books.note: 把注意、工作记忆与意识整合成框架，适合理解“认知—脑”的整体关系。
books.note_en: Integrates attention, working memory and consciousness into one framework for understanding cognition–brain relations.

books.title: Cognitive Psychology and Its Implications
books.note: 认知心理学经典，讲注意与记忆的模型，可与神经机制互相印证。
books.note_en: A cognitive psychology classic on attention and memory models that can be cross-checked against neural mechanisms.

books.title: Cognitive Psychology
books.note: 认知心理学系统教材，覆盖注意、记忆、语言等主题的概念体系。
books.note_en: A systematic cognitive psychology text covering the conceptual landscape of attention, memory and language.

books.title: Cognitive Neuroscience of Attention
books.note: 注意网络的经典专题，直接对应线索—目标范式与相关 ERP 成分。
books.note_en: The classic volume on attention networks, mapping onto cue–target paradigms and related ERP components.

books.title: Memory
books.note: 工作记忆与长时记忆的权威专题，直接支撑记忆模块的核心词条。
books.note_en: Authoritative coverage of working and long-term memory, directly supporting the memory module.

books.title: Affective Neuroscience
books.note: 情绪神经科学的奠基性专著，讲情绪系统的环路基础。
books.note_en: A founding monograph of affective neuroscience on the circuit basis of emotion.

books.title: The Emotional Brain
books.note: 以恐惧回路为例讲情绪与大脑，适合情绪模块入门。
books.note_en: Uses fear circuitry to explain emotion and the brain — a good entry to the emotion module.

books.title: 认知神经科学导论
books.note: 中文导论教材，快速建立认知神经科学基本概念与中文术语对照。
books.note_en: A Chinese introductory text for quickly building core concepts and Chinese terminology.

books.title: 认知神经科学：关于心智的生物学
authors: Gazzaniga MS 等（周晓林 等译）
books.note: 《认知神经科学》中译本，便于用中文把握认知功能与脑机制的对应。
books.note_en: Chinese translation of the mainline cognitive neuroscience text for mapping functions to brain mechanisms.
books.url: https://baike.baidu.com/item/认知神经科学：关于心智的生物学

books.title: Neuroanatomy: An Atlas of Structures, Sections, and Systems
books.note: 以图谱与切片讲清脑区结构，适合对照“脑解剖”互动模块使用。
books.note_en: Atlas and section approach to brain structures; pairs with the interactive anatomy module.

books.title: The Human Brain: An Introduction to its Functional Anatomy
books.note: 按功能系统讲脑解剖，适合把脑区与功能成对记忆。
books.note_en: Functional-systems approach to neuroanatomy, good for memorizing region–function pairs.

books.title: Neuroanatomy through Clinical Cases
books.note: 以临床病例切入解剖，强化“脑区损伤—功能缺失”的对应关系。
books.note_en: Case-based anatomy that reinforces lesion–deficit mapping.

books.title: Atlas of the Human Brain
books.note: 标准脑图谱，用于核对脑区坐标与影像定位。
books.note_en: Standard brain atlas for checking coordinates and imaging localization.

books.title: Ion Channels of Excitable Membranes
books.note: 离子通道的权威专著，解释动作电位的分子基础。
books.note_en: The authority on ion channels, explaining the molecular basis of the action potential.

books.title: Foundations of Cellular Neurophysiology
books.note: 细胞神经生理学经典，讲膜电位与突触电流的测量与建模。
books.note_en: A cellular neurophysiology classic on measuring and modeling membrane and synaptic currents.

books.title: Cellular and Molecular Neurophysiology
books.note: 从细胞与分子层讲神经生理，适合机制层面的深入学习。
books.note_en: Cellular/molecular neurophysiology for deeper mechanistic study.

books.title: The Neuron: Cell and Molecular Biology
books.note: 以神经元为单位讲细胞与分子生物学，衔接信号传导。
books.note_en: Neuron-centered cell and molecular biology, bridging to signal transduction.

books.title: Basic Neurochemistry
books.note: 神经化学权威，覆盖神经递质、受体与代谢，支撑突触模块。
books.note_en: Authoritative neurochemistry covering neurotransmitters, receptors and metabolism for the synapse module.

books.title: An Introduction to the Event-Related Potential Technique
books.note: ERP 方法圣经：实验设计、伪迹处理与成分识别，直接对应 P300/ERP 词条。
books.note_en: The ERP methods bible: design, artifact handling and component identification, mapping onto P300/ERP.

books.title: Analyzing Neural Time Series Data
books.note: EEG/MEG 时序分析实操，讲滤波、时频与统计，支撑信号处理环节。
books.note_en: Hands-on EEG/MEG time-series analysis: filtering, time-frequency and statistics.

books.title: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
books.note: fMRI 原理标准教材，讲 BOLD 信号、成像物理与实验设计。
books.note_en: The standard fMRI text on BOLD signal, imaging physics and experimental design.

books.title: Handbook of Functional MRI Data Analysis
books.note: fMRI 数据处理实操手册，从预处理到统计建模。
books.note_en: A practical fMRI data-analysis handbook from preprocessing to statistical modeling.

books.title: Electric Fields of the Brain
books.note: 脑电场的物理与理论模型，解释 EEG 的空间特性与容积传导。
books.note_en: Physical and theoretical models of brain electric fields, explaining spatial properties and volume conduction.

books.title: EEG Signal Processing
books.note: EEG 信号处理工具书，覆盖伪迹去除、特征提取与分类，直连 BCI 解码。
books.note_en: EEG signal-processing toolkit: artifact removal, feature extraction and classification, tying into BCI decoding.

books.title: MEG-EEG Primer
books.note: MEG/EEG 入门指南，讲信号的产生与测量基础。
books.note_en: An MEG/EEG primer on signal generation and measurement basics.

books.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces: Principles and Practice
books.note: BCI 领域奠基教材，系统讲范式、信号与系统设计。
books.note_en: The foundational BCI text covering paradigms, signals and system design.

books.title: Brain-Computer Interfacing: An Introduction
books.note: BCI 入门导论，讲采集、范式与解码流程，适合作为第一条主线。
books.note_en: An BCI introduction covering acquisition, paradigms and decoding — a good first mainline read.

books.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces: Revolutionizing Human-Computer Interaction
books.note: 从人机交互视角讲 BCI 的应用与交互设计。
books.note_en: BCI applications and interaction design from an HCI perspective.

books.title: Toward Brain-Computer Interfacing
books.note: 早期 BCI 经典文集，覆盖解码方法与系统实现。
books.note_en: An early BCI collection covering decoding methods and system implementations.

books.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces Handbook
books.note: BCI 手册式参考，覆盖范式、算法与应用，适合按需查证。
books.note_en: A BCI handbook covering paradigms, algorithms and applications for on-demand reference.

books.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces 1 & 2
books.note: 两卷本 BCI 教材：卷一讲基础与范式，卷二讲应用与前沿。
books.note_en: Two-volume BCI text: Vol. 1 on foundations and paradigms, Vol. 2 on applications and frontiers.

books.title: Neural Engineering
books.note: 神经工程教材，连接神经信号与工程实现（电极、采集、解码）。
books.note_en: Neural engineering linking neural signals to engineering practice (electrodes, acquisition, decoding).

books.title: Theoretical Neuroscience
books.note: 理论神经科学经典，讲编码、解码与网络模型。
books.note_en: A theoretical neuroscience classic on encoding, decoding and network models.

books.title: Neuronal Dynamics
books.note: 神经元动力学权威教材，讲脉冲神经元模型与网络动力学。
books.note_en: Authoritative neuronal dynamics text on spiking neuron models and network dynamics.

books.title: Biophysics of Computation
books.note: 计算生物物理经典，讲树突、通道与计算的物理机制。
books.note_en: A computational biophysics classic on dendrites, channels and the physics of computation.

books.title: Fundamentals of Computational Neuroscience
books.note: 计算神经科学入门，讲模型与学习的计算视角。
books.note_en: An introduction to computational neuroscience from a modeling-and-learning perspective.

books.title: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning
books.note: 机器学习经典，为 BCI 解码器（分类/回归）提供算法基础。
books.note_en: A machine learning classic providing the algorithm foundations for BCI decoders (classification/regression).

books.title: Neural Networks and Learning Machines
books.note: 神经网络经典教材，讲学习算法与网络结构。
books.note_en: A classic neural networks text on learning algorithms and architectures.

books.title: 神经科学
books.note: 中文权威神经科学教材，是术语中英对照的可靠参照。
books.note_en: An authoritative Chinese neuroscience textbook, a reliable reference for bilingual terminology.

books.title: 神经生物学
books.note: 中文神经生物学教材，便于用中文建立机制理解。
books.note_en: A Chinese neurobiology text for building mechanistic understanding in Chinese.

books.title: 生理学
books.note: 中文生理学教材，补足神经生理所需的基础生理背景。
books.note_en: A Chinese physiology text supplying the general-physiology background for neurophysiology.

books.title: 认知神经科学导论
books.note: 中文认知神经科学导论，概念入门与术语对照。
books.note_en: A Chinese cognitive neuroscience introduction for concepts and terminology.

books.title: 神经科学——探索脑（中译）
authors: Bear MF 等（王建军 主译）
books.note: 《探索脑》中译本，零基础中文读者的首选入门。
books.note_en: Chinese translation of Exploring the Brain — the top zero-basics entry for Chinese readers.

books.title: 神经科学原理（中译）
books.note: 《神经科学原理》中译本，深入机制的中文权威参考。
books.note_en: Chinese translation of Principles of Neural Science — an authoritative Chinese deep-dive.

books.title: Encyclopedia of Neuroscience
books.note: 神经科学百科，用于快速查证术语定义与背景。
books.note_en: A neuroscience encyclopedia for quick verification of definitions and background.

books.title: The Oxford Companion to the Mind
books.note: 心智百科，覆盖认知科学概念与人物，拓展视野。
books.note_en: A companion to the mind covering cognitive science concepts and figures for broader context.

books.title: The Cognitive Neurosciences
books.note: 同 #6 的综述文集，认知神经科学前沿查阅。
books.note_en: The same review collection as #6, for frontier reference in cognitive neuroscience.
